name: How much does it cost to install exterior lighting in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to install exterior lighting in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of exterior lighting installation in the Bay Area varies significantly based on several factors. These include the number and type of fixtures, the complexity of the wiring, whether new trenches need to be dug, and the materials chosen (e.g., LED vs. traditional bulbs, fixture quality). For a basic installation with a few fixtures, you might expect a certain range, while a comprehensive landscape lighting system will be considerably more. We provide detailed, transparent quotes after an on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Exterior lighting installation costs in the Bay Area depend on fixture type, quantity, wiring complexity, and materials. A detailed quote requires an on-site assessment.
